title: EU-Central compact SKUs sequenced onboarding and release sync
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Coordinate cross-functional activities to launch a compact SKU family and new reservation flex-shift option in the eu-central region. Deliverables: sequenced release notes, partner & sales enablement bundle, billing SKU mapping, console/telemetry updates, and on-call runbooks for region-specific incidents. Focus on minimizing migration friction for existing reservation holders and guaranteeing fallbacks to compatible instance types.
acceptance_criteria: Release notes drafted, reviewed by legal and billing, and published on docs.redwood.com
Billing SKU table implemented in billing service with migration mapping and QA signoff
Console region & SKU dropdown updated and validated in staging
Telemetry dashboards (tokens, latency, error-rate) deployed for eu-central and linked in the runbook
Sales & Partner kit (1-pager, pricing grid, FAQ) shared with GTM and CS teams
Rollback and fallback playbook validated in a dry run with SRE
milestones: 2025-03-14: Public documentation and release notes published
